checks: actual builder utility process is alive before preemption
cancel request retains the shared slot and platform request while the actual child remains alive
quick dispatch observes actual owned child exit before using the single slot
late maintenance reply cannot revive the exited worker
reserved capacity serves quick work while the actual builder remains alive
normal builder completion releases capacity only after child exit
battery gate defers builder before any utility-process or platform dispatch
cancelling a gated build leaves no admitted or waiting capacity
limitations: Owned development-only waiting workers and synthetic scheduler requests; not physical microphone/Word, real-cloud latency, power-device qualification or full process-tree accounting.
The shipping queue, platform cancellation bridge and builder runner execute; whole-mission preemption for ordinary missions remains separate work.
